title: Fastned - Polestar 3 111 kWh (2023-2025) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (Polestar 3 111 kWh (2023 - 2025), charger class 400), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
